strings.name: Li Shufu
strings.summary: Born in Taizhou, Li moved from refrigerator parts and motorcycles into cars, founding Geely and developing its own brands. Geely Holding acquired Volvo Cars in 2010, then expanded through international stakes and partnerships. His career illustrates private Chinese carmakers’ internationalisation and challenges of integration and technological change. In 2026 he left Geely Auto’s chairmanship while continuing to lead its parent.
